# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface

## Window Title Bar
- Application name: LibreOffice Impress
- Document name: campaign_slides.pptx
- Date and time: Oct 22 19:26
- System tray icons: Bell icon (notifications), system status icons (sound, network, etc.)

## Application Menu Bar
- Menu options: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Slide, Slide Show, Tools, Window, Help

## Toolbar
- Contains multiple tool icons for common actions:
  - File operations (new, open, save, print)
  - Drawing tools (shapes, lines, arrows, basic geometric figures)
  - Text formatting tools (font, color, alignment)
  - Slide management tools (insert, delete, duplicate)
  - Object manipulation tools (group, ungroup, align, distribute)
  - Special tools (chart, table, image, media, hyperlink, comment)

## Left Sidebar: Slides Panel
- Title: Slides
- Contains thumbnails of 4 slides:
  - Slide 1: Title "Eradicating Heritable Disorders Through Prenatal Identification" with a large white arrow graphic
  - Slide 2: Yellow background with a white arrow graphic
  - Slide 3: Yellow background with a white arrow graphic
  - Slide 4: Yellow background with a white arrow graphic (currently selected, highlighted with a brown border)
- Slide indicator at bottom: "Slide 4 of 4"

## Main Content Area
- Current slide: Slide 4
- Background: Solid yellow
- Graphic: Large white arrow pointing diagonally up and to the right
- Mouse cursor: Standard arrow cursor positioned in the center of the slide

## Right Sidebar: Properties Panel
- Panel title: Properties
- Section: Slide
  - Format: On-screen w (16:9)
  - Orientation: Landscape
  - Background: None (with "Insert Image..." button)
  - Master Slide: BLANK_4
  - Master Background: Checked
  - Master Objects: Checked
  - Master View: Button available
- Section: Layouts
  - Grid of layout thumbnails (12 total)
  - Currently selected layout: Blank layout (no text boxes or placeholders)
  - Layouts include: Title and content, title and two content areas, title and three content areas, various grid layouts

## Top Notification Bar
- Two blue informational banners:
  - "Help us make LibreOffice even better!" with "Get involved" button
  - "Your donations support our worldwide community." with "Donate" button
- Each banner has a close (X) button on the right

## Bottom Status Bar
- Slide indicator: "Slide 4 of 4"
- Slide name: "BLANK_4"
- Zoom level: "123%"
- Language: "English (en)"
- Zoom slider: Horizontal slider with zoom percentage indicator
- Coordinate display: "4.69 / 6.45" and "0.00 x 0.00"

## Left Dock: Application Icons
- Vertical dock with application icons:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress (currently active)
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Ubuntu Software
  - Help (question mark)
  - Trash

## System Interface
- Top-left: Activities button
- Top-right: Window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close)
- Bottom-left: Grid of application launcher icons

## Additional UI Elements
- Scroll bars: Vertical scroll bar on the right side of the slides panel and main content area
- Toolbars: Multiple toolbars with icons for various functions
- Contextual menus: Not visible in the current screenshot
- Status indicators: Zoom level, slide number, language, coordinates
- Navigation controls: Not visible in the current screenshot

## Layout and Design
- Overall layout: Standard LibreOffice Impress interface with menu bar, toolbar, slides panel, main content area, and properties panel
- Color scheme: Light gray background, blue notification banners, yellow slide background
- Typography: Standard system fonts for menus, buttons, and text elements
- Icons: Standard application icons and tool icons with clear visual representation

## Functional Elements
- Interactive elements: Buttons, dropdown menus, checkboxes, sliders, and clickable icons
- Editable elements: Slide content, properties, layout selection
- Navigation elements: Slide thumbnails, zoom controls, slide number indicator
- Informational elements: Notification banners, status bar, properties panel
